import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import sales_summary

summary = sales_summary.summarize(Path("sales.csv"))
sys.stderr.write(f"诊断：已统计 {summary[chr(111)+chr(114)+chr(100)+chr(101)+chr(114)+chr(95)+chr(99)+chr(111)+chr(117)+chr(110)+chr(116)]} 笔真实订单。
")
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "
")

import json
import sys
